reviews.text: The service was friendly and professional, and an appointment was made quickly for an acute problem.

Great and expert service. Tanja Hakkarainen has been a trusted veterinarian for a decade! She clearly explains the necessity and optionality of various examinations. Also offers Klarna payment options.
A warm and empathetic welcome following the cat's euthanasia. Heartfelt thanks to the veterinarian and the entire staff for taking Pulla (22 years old) to the other side of the rainbow.
Professional friendly service. And very affordable.
One doctor is behaving so inappropriately on social media that I wouldn't even bother with this.
Absolutely wonderful, empathetic service.
Highly recommended!
We visit because of our expertise. It's a bad location for us, no parking spaces next door...
Empathetic and competent service. Both the owner and the dog left with a good feeling after the visit <3

A truly competent and dog-oriented service, our dogs' situations have always been addressed holistically. From our dogs' perspective, there is a suitably relaxed atmosphere here, making it comfortable to come here, and the staff knows how to handle our timid dogs. With rescue dogs, we appreciate that the doctor clearly has a lot of knowledge and experience in the subject!
Experienced, knowledgeable doctor who focuses on the dog's situation and a very good team with the nurse. The situation was very calm and our dog was confident at the reception.
Very friendly dog ​​friendly customer service. Gets exactly the care you need in a comfortable environment where the dog feels comfortable too.
Very knowledgeable staff. Best veterinarian.
Nice to go with an uncertain rescue.
Expert doctor, good waiting area, parking next door.
Thanks for the feedback ❤️

Absolutely wonderful service and the patients are taken such good care of and genuinely cared for. Doctor Tanja, who takes care of our rescue dogs, is the best! So professional and speaks clearly and in terms that even a layman can understand. Big thanks to all of you!
Fast, friendly and knowledgeable. Vaccination visit for a basically healthy dog. The dog was always reserved at first but warmed up to this staff.

We took our kitten for vaccination there. Before a shot doctor did also basic check up to ensure that it's safe to do vaccination. Kind and attentive vet. Atmosphere in the clinic was also nice. We would definitely recommend it to others.
And the prices are affordable.

The service was very good. The prices were outrageous.

Professional and fast service, no unnecessary tests or procedures. Our previous vet recommended sedating our cat during the test because he was "challenging to handle", but Ella and Linda at Amos Clinic had no problems handling either of our cats. We will only go here in the future.
A friendly, professional and animal-oriented place where my dog ​​is always happy to come. The care here is done with a lot of heart. Thank you 💚 …

We were welcomed with professionalism and kindness. During the same trip, we successfully received a vaccination that I hadn't even realized was outdated, and I was also happy at the checkout because the price was really reasonable. We received good tips for our summer trip. I can really warmly recommend it! We became regulars at Amos right away.
